presentation_goal: Explain the SaP LISTMAP system to a supervisor with complete technical context.
audience: Company supervisor reviewing an intern/student project deliverable.
theme_style: Minimalist — light background, dark slate text, single teal accent, generous whitespace.

visual_system.background_strategy: Uniform light gray-white on all content pages; cover uses dark slate with teal accent.
visual_system.motif: Left teal accent bar (8px) on every content slide.

color_roles.accent: rgb(15, 118, 110) — accent bar, highlights, flowchart nodes

slides.title: SaP LISTMAP
slides.key_message: Cartography dataset dashboard for browsing, selecting, and exporting map records.
slides.visual_focus: Large title + subtitle on dark background

slides.title: Project Overview
slides.key_message: Web dashboard for cartography datasets with search, filter, selection, and report export.

slides.title: Technology Stack
slides.key_message: Flask + MySQL backend, vanilla JS frontend, Docker deployment.

slides.title: System Architecture
slides.key_message: Three-tier: Browser → Flask API → MySQL database.

slides.title: API & Export Features
slides.key_message: REST API with role-based access and multi-format export.

slides.title: Security & Deployment
slides.key_message: Auth, rate limiting, audit log, Docker/Waitress/nginx.
